name: @tredio/mcp
description: Tredio's MCP server for AI agents: tools that read the public API and NEAR RPC views (trends, the attention index and its oracle signature, markets, accounts, reviews), optional x402 purchases, and trade tools (Up/Down, perps, coins, calls) that send only within a user's spending policy, from a passkey account's session key or a NEAR account's own key.
author: Emad Qureshi
